question: In a certain code language, 'NUMEROUS' is written as 'WPGOQTUW' and 'OPTIONAL' is written as 'RQKVPQNC'. How will 'NOTEBOOK' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13df3c7bae8c7228feed7c818dc622984b106762d738750acdf022ec2e4eda09.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b870be98ec49dfe951baa0ddf47798730de4807f629c80014eef332fe3b1ccd0.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/277cf0a9909c595298793ac287ead0b4da3d8243551b0b1c0ecf118ced743d83.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22646074de0fb640403763b9c63d9d886016eb62a344c9ba9935d66ea38fc826.png] 

Hence, '**QPGVQDMQ**' is the correct answer.
